criteria.requirement: Extend keymap with keyword-only collision='last' and combine=None. Preserve default last-value semantics; add first, error with original-key context, and ordered combine(existing, incoming) policies. Transform each original key exactly once, preserve input mapping and factory/insertion order, propagate unhashable-key and callback errors, validate policies and expose behavior through curried/tlz without changing itemmap/merge semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
